methods.collision_backend_repair: Native-first solve uses direct Drake collision callbacks without an ordinary Python guard. Only the exact reproduced BoxBoxGradient near-contact rounding assertion permits at most one guarded recovery solve on the same mathematical program, with the same original query deadline and remaining budget; no fresh query or budget reset. Recovery retains all canonical pairs and the native aggregate, with finite-difference gradient convergence and AutoDiff chain checks. Unknown errors and non-contact disagreements still propagate; no collision constraint is dropped.
methods.collision_evaluation_accounting: native_evaluations counts only calls through the guarded Python callback. Direct native solver callback evaluations are not instrumented and their count is unknown; a saved zero means zero guarded callback calls, not zero collision work or zero native evaluations.

review_history.scope: Earlier source review; original tests and changes are retained under their existing top-level keys.

latest_review_scope: CPU derivation after strict complete-suite receipt, matrix, protocol, normalized-state, accounting and metric acceptance; no additional planning.
scsto_identity: SCSTO is EI_ZO/minimum_time, not a separate stable method ID.
source_compatibility: Current coverage uses only the explicitly accepted repaired cohorts and their frozen source/configuration. Historical OMPL native search was capped at 10 s; current cap is 60 s within the shared outer budget. Changes in results cannot be attributed solely to DRM/NTO bug repair.
shared_notes: STOMP uses an unmodified official core, while canonical cost/noise callbacks are adaptations; label does not mean the whole author task setup was copied.

CHOMP is explicitly a C-space-functional adaptation with covariant descent. TrajOpt is author SQP/BPMPD core with sampled collision adaptation. Their native smoothness/collision or squared-difference objectives are not the evaluated PWL length.

Whole-flow and fixed_initial_regions results must remain distinct. Fixed-mode eligibility uses the sealed original front-end stage, regardless of original solver success; both backends newly receive the same 60 s budget. Later graph expansion/repair is retained.

All scores require the common numerical validator. Finite collision sampling does not prove continuous collision freedom; derivative control-hull bounds are conservative continuous-segment motion-limit checks.

Normal nonconvergence and hard-query failure remain valid method observations. Native backend exceptions remain infrastructure_error. Saved valid nonconverged candidates can count only under the strict common evidence rule, never when process/timeout/array evidence contradicts them.
Keep first terminal attempt for scores; an unscored diagnostic or later witness never replaces it. No assertion of completed legacy NTO coverage is made here.

known_backend_issue.status: Known BoxBoxGradient near-contact assertion strictly repaired with native-first solve and at most one guarded recovery under the same original deadline; historical failed observations remain unchanged.
known_backend_issue.remaining_policy: Unknown backend errors remain infrastructure_error and reject completed-suite acceptance.

actual_coverage_status: All three repaired end-to-end smoke/dev/test cohorts complete and verified. Only explicitly accepted extra fixed-initial cohorts appear in current coverage.
historical_evidence_scope: Original tests, changes, limitations and review history are preserved as historical identity evidence. Current coverage and stopping conditions come only from the accepted repaired runs.

actual_coverage_evidence.counts_denominator: Legal finished queries; paired seeds are repeated queries, not independent scene layouts.

repair_review_scope: Current coverage supersedes earlier partial repair and historical scores; prior attempts remain in records.csv and original run directories.
